outline:
國際合作專題特論乃透過國際大師的講課，讓學生學習材料科學或資源工程相關領域的重要知識及了解最先進之研究成果或最新開發成品。
This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application in the materials science and mineral engineering. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.

Course Description:
This course delves into the realm of electroceramic materials. Through a
comprehensive exploration, students will gain insights into the properties,
constituents, and manufacturing techniques of electroceramic materials.
Course Objectives:
- Gain proficiency in the fundamental theories underlying diverse electroceramic
materials.
- Explore the myriad properties exhibited by electroceramic materials.
- Examine the wide-ranging applications of electroceramic materials.
